title: EmbeddedServiceLabel - Data API
description: Represents a customized label in Embedded Chat or embedded Appointment Management.This object is available in API version 44.0 and later.

CustomLabelName.description: The developer name for the custom label.

LabelKey.properties: Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort
LabelKey.description: The type of label for this embedded component. The value corresponds to the label within a label group (substate of chat state or page type).

wsdl_segment:
```xml
<complexType name="EmbeddedServiceLabel">
  <complexContent>
    <extension base="ens:sObject">
      <sequence>
        <element name="CustomLabelName" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:string"/>
        <element name="DurableId" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:string"/>
        <element name="EmbeddedServiceConfigDeveloperName" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:string"/>
        <element name="LabelKey" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:string"/>
      </sequence>
    </extension>
  </complexContent>
</complexType>
```
